security_rif_criterion_008.answer: A points-based rubric weighing: 1) Previous Year's Final Evaluation (0-50 pts); 2) Unique Skills and Qualifications (0-20 pts); 3) Other Contributions to Local Educational Program (0-20 pts); 4) Length of Service (1-10 pts, +5 credit for DC residency/veteran status). The teacher with the lowest total point value is excessed first.
security_rif_criterion_008.evidence: DCPS shall retain the right to make the final excessing decision according to the following rubric: [points table] ... The Teacher in the competitive area (as determined in accordance with Title 5 of the DCMR) with the lowest point value overall according to the rubric above shall be the first Teacher to be excessed.
